A '''flight suit''' was a one-piece coverall, including a [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]], that provided life support, protected against hostile environments, and prevented the wearer from being adversely affected from the g-force effects commonly associated with high-velocity flying; essentially, very compact [[Environment_suit/Legends|Environment Suits]]. The flight suit weighed three [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]], and could provide life support in outer space for up to 10 [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. A flight suit would cost 1000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], compared to the [[Padded flight suit|padded version]] that would cost 2000 credits.<ref name="Saga Edition" />
